race.comment: HELLFIRE HENRY (1) gets the nod on recent substance after starting favourite at his past two runs and staying on well enough to remain a strong Maiden chance. He was beaten just over a length at this track two back, then led and held on until late when fourth to King Julian at Bathurst, with the first-time visor an added point of interest. PARIAH TIME (2) is the main danger after resuming with a fourth at this venue, beaten a length by Petomai, and his broader record of three placings from seven starts reads well for this sort of assignment. RESCHS MILK (5) resumes for a new stable after finishing close up over 2100m at Gosford and placing at Newcastle on heavy ground, with a Canberra trial last month giving her some fitness base. TOP PICK (6) has been away much longer, but two placings from three starts and a recent Canberra trial give her a genuine place profile if she returns in order.
